figurative_meaning_en: The conversation is over; the story is finished
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে যা বলেছে তা সত্যি, এরপর কথা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: What he said is true, end of story.
A mistake was made, case closed.
note: This idiom emphasizes abrupt closure in discussions, rooted in oral traditions.
